unit_of_analysis: step (one Cognitive Tutor problem-solving transaction; identified by Problem Hierarchy||Problem Name||Step Name). NOT one 'question' -- see module docstring.
response_field: Correct First Attempt (1=correct on first attempt, 0=incorrect/hint-first)
decoupling_definition: decoupling(A,B) = (n_A_only + n_B_only) / (n_A_only + n_B_only + n_both), where a 'slot' is one interaction event whose tagged KC set includes A and/or B, n_both = slots tagging both simultaneously (co-scheduled practice), n_A_only/n_B_only = slots tagging exactly one. This is the real-data, direction-symmetric analogue of the qmirt-archaeology positivity condition ('fraction of source-only practice slots', >=0.75 clean / 0 unidentifiable) -- see triage_common.py module docstring for the full derivation and the two directional readings reported alongside it.

e_decoupling.ranking: top pairs by n_both (co-occurring practice slots), restricted to n_both > 0
